episode_summary: This episode dives into the ongoing dispute between Compass, Zillow, and MLS, exploring its implications for agents. Ben Lalez shares innovative AI-driven solutions for common real estate challenges, such as predicting transaction cancellations and automating content creation. The discussion emphasizes the importance of agent independence and leveraging technology to stay competitive.
